scripts.pre-commit: cd api && npm run pre-commit && cd ../client && npm run pre-commit
scripts.install-dependencies: npm install && cd api && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: cd api && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
scripts.start:dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,client "npm --prefix api start" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.start:cypress: concurrently --kill-others --names api,client "npm --prefix api run start:test" "npm --prefix client run start:cypress"
scripts.start:production: cd api && npm run start:production && cd ../client && npm run start:production
